sourceCoverage.rationale: The draft covers the model lineage, measured fact and framing scores, training method, and capability checks.

supportingArgument.rationale: The matched developer comparison measures targeted changes against the base model under the documented settings.

evidenceRoles.rationale: The three cited records come from the developer. A public benchmark permits replication but does not supply it.

counterargument.rationale: The article explains why public materials and a blinded model judge add value even when the rubric has limits.

tradeoffs.rationale: The article distinguishes improved factual coverage from a change in refusal or framing behavior.

falsifiability.rationale: A proposed blind comparison specifies held-out prompts, matched settings, separate scores and a basis for reconsidering adoption.

originalSynthesis.rationale: The article ties adoption to whether the improvement survives a different rubric, topic mix and reviewer.

performance.rationale: The article scopes the capability claim to the developer’s two measured benchmarks and notes harness differences.

economics.rationale: The video and reviewed reports do not establish comparative serving costs or an economic decision.

threatGovernance.rationale: The draft distinguishes ordinary quality, unsupported assertions, and safeguards for politically sensitive answers.

gaps.rationale: The candidate is open for structural and preview checks. An independent exact-copy review remains pending.
